items_flat.title_en: OpenAI closes first $11B tranche at $1.25T valuation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 以 1.25 兆美元估值完成首筆 110 億美元融資
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg and Reuters reported that OpenAI closed roughly $11 billion of a larger round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion, with funds wired as of Friday. The target had been scaled back from earlier $30B+ / $1.4-1.5T ambitions amid market cooling; the remainder could reach about $20 billion. SoftBank, MGX, Coatue and others participated. OpenAI has not officially confirmed.
items_flat.summary_zh: Bloomberg 與 Reuters 報導，OpenAI 已完成約 110 億美元的首輪融資，公司估值為 1.25 兆美元，資金於週五入帳。目標從先前超過 300 億美元／1.4-1.5 兆美元下修；剩餘部分或可達約 200 億美元。SoftBank、MGX、Coatue 等參與。OpenAI 尚未官方確認。
items_flat.analysis_en: This sets a new private-market benchmark just as Anthropic’s IPO is being re-priced lower in the same sell-off, highlighting how quickly AI valuations are adjusting to public-market sentiment and data-center spend concerns.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這在 Anthropic IPO 同步下修的背景下，設立新的私募基準，顯示 AI 估值正快速因應公開市場情緒與資料中心支出疑慮調整。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic IPO valuation talks center on $1.25-1.75T ahead of Thanksgiving
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 估值討論集中在 1.25-1.75 兆美元，目標感恩節前上市
items_flat.summary_en: Following its October S-1 filing (ticker ANT), Anthropic is reportedly targeting an $80-100B raise at a $1.25-1.75 trillion valuation before the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday, down from earlier ~$2T discussions. Roadshow timing and exact terms remain fluid; Q3 revenue reached nearly $17B.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月提交 S-1（代號 ANT）後，據報目標在美國感恩節前以 1.25-1.75 兆美元估值募資 800-1000 億美元，低於先前約 2 兆美元的討論。路演時程與確切條款仍變動中；第三季營收近 170 億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The downward revision mirrors the OpenAI funding adjustment and signals that even the strongest private AI labs are pricing against a cooler public market and post-midterm regulatory and infrastructure scrutiny.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 下修與 OpenAI 融資調整呼應，顯示即使最強私營 AI 實驗室也正以較冷的公開市場與期中選舉後監管及基建審視來定價。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber for authorized vulnerability research
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 Cyber，供授權弱點研究使用
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5, OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized variant of GPT-6 Astra rated Critical for cybersecurity under its Preparedness Framework. It is restricted to Daybreak Red customers for authorized vulnerability discovery, exploit development and testing; OpenAI reported strong gains on ExploitGym and real-world Linux/Firefox findings.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 5 日，OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Cyber，為 GPT-6 Astra 的專門變體，依 Preparedness Framework 評為資安 Critical。僅限 Daybreak Red 客戶用於授權弱點發現、漏洞利用與測試；OpenAI 報告在 ExploitGym 與實際 Linux／Firefox 發現上有顯著進展。
items_flat.analysis_en: Restricted access and Critical rating reflect the dual-use risks of stronger cyber capabilities; practical value depends on how quickly authorized defenders can leverage it versus potential misuse outside the program.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 受限存取與 Critical 評級反映更強資安能力的雙重用途風險；實用價值取決於授權防禦方多快能善用，相對於計畫外潛在濫用。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, a major leap in security research: more capable at finding and fixing vulnerabilities, and far more reliable staying within the boundaries researchers set.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 GPT‑6 Cyber，這是資安研究的重大飛躍：更能發現與修復弱點，且更能可靠地留在研究人員設定的範圍內。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind AI agents find two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind AI 代理發現傳統 1024 位元 RSA 兩個弱點
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6, Google DeepMind announced that human-guided AI agents identified two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA: a signature-forgery approach estimated ~1,600× faster for short digests under partial control, and a batch-factoring method. Results are theoretical or limited to retired key sizes; RSA-2048 and larger remain unaffected.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 6 日，Google DeepMind 宣布，由人類引導的 AI 代理在傳統 1024 位元 RSA 中發現兩個弱點：部分控制下短摘要的簽章偽造估計快約 1600 倍，以及批次分解方法。結果屬理論或限於已淘汰金鑰尺寸；RSA-2048 及以上不受影響。
items_flat.analysis_en: While limited to retired key sizes and theoretical/sandbox results, the work demonstrates AI agents accelerating cryptanalysis research; practical impact on live systems remains low for now.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雖限於已淘汰金鑰尺寸與理論／沙盒結果，此工作顯示 AI 代理可加速密碼分析研究；目前對現行系統的實際影響仍低。

items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available with 15-second clips
items_flat.title_zh: Google 將 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 全面開放，支援 15 秒影片
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash on November 5, making it generally available on the Gemini API, Gemini for business, and Google Cloud. It supports native 15-second video generation and editing (up from 10s), stronger reference adherence, and lower pricing (720p ~$0.07/s, ~30% below prior).
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 5 日宣布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，並在 Gemini API、Gemini for business 與 Google Cloud 全面開放。支援原生 15 秒影片生成與編輯（由 10 秒提升），更強參考遵循，以及更低價格（720p 約每秒 0.07 美元，較先前低約 30%）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands practical multimodal video tools for business and developer use at lower cost, though audio references remain allowlisted and higher resolutions are upscaled rather than native.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這以較低成本擴展企業與開發者的實用多模態影片工具，但音訊參考仍需白名單，且更高解析度為上採樣而非原生。
items_flat.quote: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash introduces native 15-second video creation, multi-turn conversational editing capabilities, and enhanced reference following. We have dropped the price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 making it available at $0.07 per second for 720p video.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash引入原生15秒影片創作、多輪對話式編輯能力與強化的參考遵循。我們將價格從Gemini Omni 1.1降低30%，使720p影片以每秒0.07美元提供。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Spaces: custom experiences inside Muse
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出 Spaces：Muse 內的自訂體驗
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6, Meta launched Spaces in the Muse app. Users describe an idea in chat and Muse builds a persistent, interactive space (tracker, planner, dashboard, game) that lives in the sidebar or main tabs and can pull data from connected apps.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 6 日，Meta 在 Muse 應用程式推出 Spaces。使用者在聊天中描述想法，Muse 即建立持久的互動空間（追蹤器、規劃器、儀表板、遊戲），可置於側邊欄或主標籤，並從連接應用程式拉取資料。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves Muse further toward persistent personal agents and mini-apps, increasing stickiness, though long-term utility depends on reliability of background updates and integration depth.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這讓 Muse 更接近持久個人代理與迷你應用，提升黏著度，但長期效用取決於背景更新可靠性與整合深度。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re introducing spaces, an interactive way to build a more personalized Muse. A space is a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 spaces，這是打造更個人化 Muse 的互動方式。space 是你在 Muse 內透過描述想法所建立的自訂體驗。

items_flat.title_en: Google acquires Crusoe’s unfinished Wyoming data-center site, plans $17B investment
items_flat.title_zh: Google 收購 Crusoe 未完工懷俄明資料中心場地，計畫投資 170 億美元
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6, Crusoe confirmed it sold its southeast Wyoming data-center development site to Google. Google announced a $17 billion investment to develop its first Wyoming campus (partnering with Tallgrass and others). Terms of the site acquisition were not disclosed.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 6 日，Crusoe 確認將其東南懷俄明資料中心開發場地出售給 Google。Google 宣布投資 170 億美元開發其首座懷俄明園區（與 Tallgrass 等合作）。場地收購條款未披露。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hyperscalers continuing to absorb independent projects underscores the capital intensity and execution risk of multi-GW AI campuses amid local and political pushback.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 超大規模業者持續吸收獨立專案，凸顯多 GW AI 園區的資本密集與執行風險，以及地方與政治阻力。

items_flat.title_en: Musk announces overnight Grok Bot fixes after engineering roundtable
items_flat.title_zh: Musk 宣布工程圓桌後隔夜修復 Grok Bot
items_flat.summary_en: On November 9 (UTC), Elon Musk posted that he held a round-table review with the Grok Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight; users should notice a dramatic improvement by the next day. He invited immediate feedback if issues remain.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 9 日（UTC），Elon Musk 貼文表示與 Grok Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌檢討。修復將於隔夜實施；使用者隔天應會注意到顯著改善。他邀請若仍有問題立即回覆。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public acknowledgment of recent reliability/cost issues and a concrete overnight commitment is notable for user trust, but actual impact depends on the unstated scope of the fixes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開承認近期可靠性／成本問題並承諾隔夜修復，對使用者信任有意義，但實際影響取決於未說明的修復範圍。
items_flat.quote: Just did a round table review with the Grok @Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight and you should notice a dramatic improvement by tomorrow.
items_flat.quote_zh: 剛與 Grok @Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌檢討。修復將於隔夜實施，你明天應該會注意到顯著改善。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI partners with Hacktron to strengthen its own security
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 Hacktron 合作強化自身資安
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6, OpenAI announced a partnership with Hacktron to identify vulnerabilities in its systems, focusing on third-party integrations. It is expanding Hacktron’s Daybreak Red access and raised bug-bounty rewards.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 6 日，OpenAI 宣布與 Hacktron 合作，找出其系統弱點，聚焦第三方整合。公司正擴大 Hacktron 的 Daybreak Red 存取，並提高漏洞賞金。
items_flat.analysis_en: Using external specialized agents on its own stack is a practical acknowledgment that frontier labs must continuously red-team themselves as agent connectivity grows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 使用外部專門代理測試自身系統，實務上承認隨著代理連接增加，前沿實驗室必須持續自我紅隊測試。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re announcing a partnership with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布與 Hacktron 合作，找出 OpenAI 系統中的弱點。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases BioBasicsBench for wet-lab agent evaluation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 BioBasicsBench 評估濕實驗室代理
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6, OpenAI introduced BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark developed with Ligo that tests whether AI agents can interpret raw wet-lab experimental data (gels, plates, instrument readouts) and recognize when evidence is insufficient.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 6 日，OpenAI 推出 BioBasicsBench，與 Ligo 合作開發的 100 任務基準，測試 AI 代理能否解讀原始濕實驗室實驗資料（凝膠、培養皿、儀器讀數），並識別證據不足的情況。
items_flat.analysis_en: Fills a practical gap between polished paper figures and real lab ambiguity; early scores show progress but leave substantial room on image interpretation and controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 填補精緻論文圖表與真實實驗室模糊性之間的實務缺口；早期分數顯示進展，但在影像解讀與對照上仍有大幅空間。
items_flat.quote: Introducing BioBasicsBench, a benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data across 100 routine wet-lab tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 推出 BioBasicsBench，這是衡量 AI 代理在 100 項常規濕實驗室任務中解讀原始實驗資料能力的基準。

google.title_en: Google acquires Crusoe’s unfinished Wyoming data-center site, plans $17B investment
google.title_zh: Google 收購 Crusoe 未完工懷俄明資料中心場地，計畫投資 170 億美元
google.summary_en: On November 6, Crusoe confirmed it sold its southeast Wyoming data-center development site to Google. Google announced a $17 billion investment to develop its first Wyoming campus (partnering with Tallgrass and others). Terms of the site acquisition were not disclosed.
google.summary_zh: 11 月 6 日，Crusoe 確認將其東南懷俄明資料中心開發場地出售給 Google。Google 宣布投資 170 億美元開發其首座懷俄明園區（與 Tallgrass 等合作）。場地收購條款未披露。
google.analysis_en: Hyperscalers continuing to absorb independent projects underscores the capital intensity and execution risk of multi-GW AI campuses amid local and political pushback.
google.analysis_zh: 超大規模業者持續吸收獨立專案，凸顯多 GW AI 園區的資本密集與執行風險，以及地方與政治阻力。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Spaces: custom experiences inside Muse
meta.title_zh: Meta 推出 Spaces：Muse 內的自訂體驗
meta.summary_en: On November 6, Meta launched Spaces in the Muse app. Users describe an idea in chat and Muse builds a persistent, interactive space (tracker, planner, dashboard, game) that lives in the sidebar or main tabs and can pull data from connected apps.
meta.summary_zh: 11 月 6 日，Meta 在 Muse 應用程式推出 Spaces。使用者在聊天中描述想法，Muse 即建立持久的互動空間（追蹤器、規劃器、儀表板、遊戲），可置於側邊欄或主標籤，並從連接應用程式拉取資料。
meta.analysis_en: This moves Muse further toward persistent personal agents and mini-apps, increasing stickiness, though long-term utility depends on reliability of background updates and integration depth.
meta.analysis_zh: 這讓 Muse 更接近持久個人代理與迷你應用，提升黏著度，但長期效用取決於背景更新可靠性與整合深度。
meta.quote: Today we’re introducing spaces, an interactive way to build a more personalized Muse. A space is a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 spaces，這是打造更個人化 Muse 的互動方式。space 是你在 Muse 內透過描述想法所建立的自訂體驗。

xai.title_en: Musk announces overnight Grok Bot fixes after engineering roundtable
xai.title_zh: Musk 宣布工程圓桌後隔夜修復 Grok Bot
xai.summary_en: On November 9 (UTC), Elon Musk posted that he held a round-table review with the Grok Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight; users should notice a dramatic improvement by the next day. He invited immediate feedback if issues remain.
xai.summary_zh: 11 月 9 日（UTC），Elon Musk 貼文表示與 Grok Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌檢討。修復將於隔夜實施；使用者隔天應會注意到顯著改善。他邀請若仍有問題立即回覆。
xai.analysis_en: Public acknowledgment of recent reliability/cost issues and a concrete overnight commitment is notable for user trust, but actual impact depends on the unstated scope of the fixes.
xai.analysis_zh: 公開承認近期可靠性／成本問題並承諾隔夜修復，對使用者信任有意義，但實際影響取決於未說明的修復範圍。
xai.quote: Just did a round table review with the Grok @Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight and you should notice a dramatic improvement by tomorrow.
xai.quote_zh: 剛與 Grok @Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌檢討。修復將於隔夜實施，你明天應該會注意到顯著改善。

brief_en: OpenAI closed its first $11B at a $1.25T valuation while expanding cyber tooling; Anthropic’s pre-Thanksgiving IPO is being priced lower amid the same cooling; Google DeepMind advanced cryptanalysis research and Gemini Omni video; Meta added custom Spaces to Muse; xAI’s Musk pledged overnight Grok Bot fixes.
brief_zh: OpenAI 以 1.25 兆美元估值完成首筆 110 億美元融資並擴展資安工具；Anthropic IPO 估值下修；DeepMind 推進 RSA 分析與 Omni 影片；Meta 為 Muse 新增 Spaces；Musk 承諾 Grok Bot 隔夜修復。
